chart_contract.finding: Preservation exceeds redevelopment by 41 percentage points in simulated data

Tick Donut slows comparison between the two leading shares
Radial convergence introduces relationship geometry absent from the data

Tick rows compare values but lose the ballot-like respondent cadence
Dot cascade requires short vertical labels and creates unnecessary descent geometry
